description: Report to Dropyour a defect of the PLATFORM that dropyour_support diagnosed (side: platform, reportable: true). This WRITES: one report per cause, per app, per day (later ones attach to the first), and one line in the account's activity under your name. It takes a cause from a closed vocabulary and no free text. What is sent: the cited facts reduced to codes, counts and dates, the app id and the account reference; never page content, never the conversation, never a log line. It is refused when the facts do not put the cause on the platform's side. Ask the user before calling it. Dropyour answers the user in their cockpit; no delay is promised. Needs a connected account.

cause.description: The cause returned by dropyour_support in actions[].args.cause.

name: dropyour_support_report
title: Report a platform defect to Dropyour
